full_details: The light went before four. Frost was on the stones of Crosby Place, where a man lives who is no longer Mayor. You did not go across to him. The loaf was a penny, and two fingers short of the old notch. After supper you ruled a line and cast the year. Thirty-three pounds ten, counted twice, from twenty-four pounds ten at the start. Received fifty-five pounds fourteen. Laid out forty-six pounds fourteen. My lord's ten shillings has its own line. The three nights stay expected, and not received. Quiney still owes a pound. You did not write what lies at the bottom of the coffer. You put a new penny almanac, unmarked, on the old one. You did not write a reason beside twenty pounds you mean not to spend. Then you lit a fresh candle and took up the twelfth leaf.
one_sentence: You cast the year at thirty-three pounds ten, and took up the twelfth leaf.
title: Thirty-three pounds ten, counted twice
